rules.title: Rust 1.98 and older are no longer supported
rules.summary: The Rust project only provides support and security updates for the most recent stable release, so a release line is unsupported once the next stable release ships. Rust 1.99 was released on 2026-10-01.

constraints: Keep the toolchain in rust-toolchain(.toml), CI (for example dtolnay/rust-toolchain or rustup), and container images on one supported release.
Check the project's MSRV (`rust-version`) separately: raising the toolchain does not require raising it.

steps.title: Raise the pinned toolchain
steps.instructions: Change the reported channel in rust-toolchain(.toml) to the latest stable release, or to `stable`, so the project follows supported releases.

steps.title: Align other toolchain surfaces
steps.instructions: Update CI toolchain setup and Dockerfile `rust:` images so they match the new release.

verification.purpose: Confirm the active toolchain is the intended release.
Build and test every target on the new toolchain.
Review the lints the newer toolchain reports.

rules.title: failure is no longer maintained
rules.summary: The failure crate is officially end-of-life: its former maintainer marked it deprecated and announced there will be no further updates or maintenance.

constraints: Keep error types, `Display` output, and public error conversions stable for callers of this crate.

steps.title: Replace failure
steps.instructions: Replace failure with anyhow for application errors or thiserror/snafu for library error types, and update `Fail` derives, `failure::Error`, and `format_err!` uses.

verification.purpose: Build and test after the error-handling change.

rules.title: tempdir is no longer maintained
rules.summary: The tempdir crate has been deprecated and its functionality merged into tempfile.

constraints: Keep temporary directories cleaned up on drop, as before.

steps.title: Replace tempdir with tempfile
steps.instructions: Replace the tempdir dependency with tempfile and change `TempDir::new(prefix)` calls to `tempfile::tempdir()` or `tempfile::Builder`.

verification.purpose: Build and run the tests that create temporary directories.

rules.title: atty is no longer maintained
rules.summary: The maintainer of atty has published an official notice that the crate is no longer under development and that users should rely on the standard library's IsTerminal trait.
rules.replacement: std::io::IsTerminal (stable since Rust 1.70), or the is-terminal crate for older compilers

constraints: Preserve how colored or interactive output is chosen when stdout or stderr is not a terminal.

steps.title: Use std::io::IsTerminal
steps.instructions: Replace `atty::is(Stream::Stdout)` with `std::io::stdout().is_terminal()` (stable since Rust 1.70, `use std::io::IsTerminal`), or use the is-terminal crate on older compilers, and remove the atty dependency.

verification.purpose: Build and test after removing atty.

rules.title: ansi_term is no longer maintained
rules.summary: The maintainer has advised that ansi_term is deprecated and will not receive any maintenance.
rules.replacement: A maintained terminal-styling crate (the advisory lists unvetted alternatives such as anstyle, nu-ansi-term, owo-colors, and console)

constraints: Keep the same colors and styles in terminal output.

steps.title: Replace ansi_term
steps.instructions: Replace ansi_term with a maintained styling crate (the advisory lists anstyle, nu-ansi-term, owo-colors, and console as unvetted options) and update `Style`, `Colour`, and `ANSIString` uses.

verification.purpose: Build and test after the styling change.
